segments.name: S&P Global Market Intelligence
segments.description: Provides multi-asset-class data, analytics and workflow solutions for investment professionals, corporations, governments and universities.
segments.evidence: Market Intelligence is a global provider of multi-asset-class data and analytics integrated with purpose-built workflow solutions.

segments.name: S&P Global Ratings
segments.description: Independent provider of credit ratings, research and analytics serving investors, corporations, governments, banks and other debt issuers.
segments.evidence: Ratings is an independent provider of credit ratings, research, and analytics.

segments.name: S&P Global Energy
segments.description: Provides price data, benchmarks, analytics and software for energy and commodity market participants.
segments.evidence: Energy is a leading independent provider of information and benchmark prices for the energy and commodity markets.

segments.name: S&P Global Mobility
segments.description: Serves the automotive value chain including OEMs, suppliers, dealerships, consumers and finance and insurance companies.
segments.evidence: Mobility is a leading provider of solutions serving the full automotive value chain including vehicle manufacturers (Original Equipment Manufacturers or OEMs), automotive suppliers, mobility service providers, retailers, consumers, and finance and insurance companies.

segments.name: S&P Dow Jones Indices
products: Data and customized index subscription fees
segments.description: Global index provider maintaining valuation and index benchmarks for investment advisors, wealth managers and institutional investors.
segments.evidence: Indices is a global index provider maintaining a wide variety of valuation and index benchmarks for investment advisors, wealth managers and institutional investors.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay subscription fees for data, analytics and software, transaction fees for credit ratings on new debt issuance, usage-based royalties for licensed benchmarks and price data, and asset-linked fees tied to funds tracking its indices.
revenueModel.evidence: Indices derives revenue from asset-linked fees when investors direct funds into its proprietary designed or owned indexes, sales-usage based royalties of its indices, as well as data subscription arrangements.

changes.text: In 2025, the Board decided to pursue a full separation of the Mobility segment via a tax-free spin-off expected to be completed mid-2026.
changes.evidence: On April 29, 2025, we announced that our Board of Directors decided to pursue a full separation of our Mobility segment, creating a new publicly traded company.
